name: Avellaneda-Stoikov market making (Hummingbot)

origin.source_title: High-frequency trading in a limit order book (Quantitative Finance)

how_it_works.simple: You keep offering to buy a little below the price and sell a little above it, earning the gap. If you end up holding too much, you shift your prices to get rid of it.
how_it_works.analogy: Like a currency exchange booth at an airport that buys and sells at different rates and changes its rates if it runs low on euros.
how_it_works.precise: Quote around a reservation price r = s - q*gamma*sigma^2*(T - t) that leans against inventory q, with an optimal total spread gamma*sigma^2*(T - t) + (2/gamma)*ln(1 + gamma/kappa). Gamma is risk aversion, sigma volatility, kappa the order-arrival decay with distance from mid.

rule: Every tick, compute mid s, inventory q and recent volatility sigma; post bid at r - delta/2 and ask at r + delta/2 using the formulas above with chosen gamma and kappa, cancel and replace when the quote drifts beyond a tolerance, and stop at the end of the session.
data_needed: Level 2 order book and trade ticks
economic_rationale: Market makers earn the bid-ask spread as payment for providing liquidity and bearing inventory risk.
why_it_might_fail: Retail bots face adverse selection from faster traders and pay fees that professional makers avoid. In Falces Marin et al. (2022) the tuned Avellaneda-Stoikov baseline had negative mean daily Sharpe on 30 BTC-USD test days.

reported_results.source: Falces Marin, Diaz Pardo de Vera, Lopez Gonzalo (2022), PLOS ONE
reported_results.notes: Mean daily (not annualized) Sharpe of the genetically tuned AS model; median -0.26. Fixed-spread baselines -0.43 and -0.36; the deep-RL Alpha-AS variants -0.11 to -0.13. All variants lost money on average. Fees, latency and queue modeling not described on the page.

post_publication_evidence: Hummingbot moved its Avellaneda strategy to a legacy 'V1 strategies' section and makes no performance claims; the docs warn that the optimal spread can push bids to zero or below in some settings.

relevance.reason: Needs tick data and low latency; not testable or competitive for a student FX vs S&P 500 project.
